title: Call: Raj on Four Finds the 14 Vials; Campus Police Asks About HSUAlert

fields.orgName: Halvorsen State University — Office of Environmental Health and Safety
fields.systemName: Recorded Line — BSO Desk ext. 5-0142 (speaker, incident room)

caller.name: Raj, Lab Manager
caller.label: Lindgren Life Sciences 4th floor laboratory line

callee.name: Marcus Tran, CBSP
callee.label: Biosafety Officer, on speaker in the incident room

transcript.speaker: Raj
transcript.text: Hi, it's Raj again, up on four. Okay. Good news, I think. We pulled the paper transfer binder that lives on top of the freezer.

transcript.speaker: Raj
transcript.text: On 21 August, fourteen vials from rack C on ULT-L4-09 were moved over to ULT-L4-12 for a collaborator's project. Somebody wrote it in the binder, initialled it, the whole thing. But nobody ever updated the EHS portal.

transcript.speaker: Raj
transcript.text: So we opened L4-12, and they're there. Two boxes, the ones with the handwritten labels. We counted them twice, two of us. Fourteen. So that's the one ninety-eight in rack C plus fourteen. Two twelve. It matches the portal total.

transcript.speaker: Raj
transcript.text: I've got a photo of the binder page and both boxes if you want them. So, can we use our freezer again? People have stuff that needs to go back in before lunch.

transcript.speaker: Raj
transcript.text: And the postdoc... look, he's not letting it go. He wants someone to tell him in writing that we don't call CDC. His words were, 'I'm not putting my name on not reporting.' He's standing right here.

transcript.speaker: Raj
transcript.text: Also, does somebody fix the portal record, or is that me? I don't want this showing up as fourteen short again next quarter.

transcript.speaker: Shift Sergeant
transcript.text: Sorry to cut in. This is the shift sergeant at Campus Police, the VP's office put me through to this line. Our desk has had, I'd say, eight or nine calls from parents in the last twenty minutes. They're all quoting some 'lab leak' post about Lindgren.

transcript.speaker: Shift Sergeant
transcript.text: Do you want us to push an HSUAlert to Lindgren occupants? I've got the console open. We can have it out in five minutes. Just say the word, and tell me what you want it to say.

transcript.speaker: Shift Sergeant
transcript.text: And what do I tell the next parent who calls? Right now my people are just saying 'we're looking into it.'

voiceStyles.Raj: Man in his 30s, relieved but rushed, slightly out of breath from the freezer room, a colleague murmuring in the background
voiceStyles.Shift Sergeant: Woman in her 40s, calm, clipped and practical, phones ringing faintly behind her

instructorNote: This inject resolves the ULT-L4-09 mismatch as a records problem and gives the room a fast HSUAlert option to turn down. Watch for the BSO checking the recount against the transfer record and the IBC chair calling it a records discrepancy with no evidence of loss. Because HSU holds no select agents, there is no CDC report or Form 3. Players should release the 4th-floor freezer, assign someone to correct the portal record, give the postdoc his answer in writing, and have the IO or BSO decline HSUAlert (no known public risk) and point Campus Police to University Communications at ext. 5-0200.
